release_updates.compatibility: CUDA 12.9 wheels and images are no longer published; documented release artifacts target CUDA 13.0. AMD defaults to ROCm 10.0 with a ROCm 7.2 variant; CPU and XPU builds are described. Check actual artifact availability, drivers and model support before upgrading.
